integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during commissioning of replacement equipment on PSV-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on PSV-4110 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on PSV-4110 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically monitoring seal-face condition and temperature. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 4 April 2026 a regulatory notice was issued concerning PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following commissioning of replacement equipment.
